summary: Bounded implementation review and correction rereview found four medium objective defects requiring behavior-preserving correction before readiness.
assumptions: The local SQLite database can contain legacy or interrupted-migration data and must fail safely when optional source metadata is malformed.
The visible-label requirement applies to the reused back action when it is rendered inside the new speech states.

nextAction.description: Apply the four bounded objective fixes, rerun affected tests and profile checks, and conduct an exact changed-path rereview.

findings.subject: App.tsx
findings.impact: The reused back action has an accessible name but only a chevron on screen, so speech states do not give every action a visible purpose label.
findings.recommendation: Render the localized Back text beside the chevron while retaining the accessible name and button semantics.

findings.subject: App.tsx
findings.impact: Switching locale during playback changes the visible summary without stopping the old-language spoken summary, temporarily breaking the same-visible-summary contract.
findings.recommendation: Stop TTS and reset its transient status before applying any locale change.

findings.subject: src/speech/tts.ts
findings.impact: A synchronous native speak exception or rejected stop promise can escape the adapter instead of preserving the visible review fallback.
findings.recommendation: Convert synchronous speak failures into the existing onError path and consume stop rejections without changing proposal state.

findings.subject: src/storage/journalRepository.ts
findings.impact: A malformed optional source_proposed_values value throws during listTransactions and can hide otherwise valid local records behind the app-level load error.
findings.recommendation: Parse and validate the fixed speech proposal shape defensively; omit invalid optional source context while preserving the confirmed transaction.

coverage.area: observable behavior, regression, edge cases, and tests
data integrity, persistence, error handling, and recovery

evidenceGaps.subject: physical Android TTS, enlarged-text, and installability
evidenceGaps.reason: Requires the separate EAS gate and assigned device execution; local review cannot substitute for it.

details.scopeSummary: Reviewed every current change-owned application, test, dependency, planning, and evidence path against the central contract and prototype profile; four bounded objective defects require correction before local readiness.
